exposure: macro-nutrient composition, used as a preload
comparative treatment consisting of a milk powder with similar energy content
Control group (milk powder with similar energy content)
finding: A macronutrient preload, compared to a control treatment, effectively controlled FBG and 2h-PBG in women with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in delivery mode between the intervention group (macronutrient preload) and the control group.
